releaseCaution: Native Hortator Acid, MIDI-only generation and restored buffer headroom. The creator confirmed stable playback on audio-base build 20261108.6. This revision fills empty T5/T6 with Acid/Break on confirmed six-track activation, skips EMPTY during preset browsing and starts fresh SCL in CHR. Existing assignments, notes and stored scales are preserved. Busy six-track arrangements still need CPU headroom. Back up before installation.
